name: @wcdraft/data
description: Curated wcdraft runtime datasets and access helpers. Compact bundles built deterministically from the ETL output, distributed under CC-BY-SA 4.0 with full source attribution. See README for the attribution obligation.

scripts.test:golden:data: node scripts/ensure-generated-artifacts.mjs && vitest run test/compact-data.golden.test.ts test/compact-data.integrity.test.ts test/score-distribution.golden.test.ts test/daily-seed-salt-map.golden.test.ts
scripts.test:golden:integration: node scripts/ensure-generated-artifacts.mjs && vitest run test/e2e-real-run.golden.test.ts test/era-presets.golden.test.ts
scripts.test:realism:heavy: node scripts/ensure-generated-artifacts.mjs && WCDRAFT_REALISM_HEAVY=1 vitest run test/realism/realism.gate.test.ts
